decision: Can native self-search produce a retained model that improves certified search on prospectively frozen construction roots and correctly reuses checked definition identities?

diagnosis.retired_engineering_evidence: The original selection reached 7/32 for both the fresh and trained default-seed policy. Forty-two training states improved from 17 to 41 correct first actions, without certified selection gain. Repeated attempts and the earlier 200-case confirmation are development evidence only.
source_changes: Introduce fresh witnesses for negated universals and discharge them through ordinary native proofs.
Treat certificate resource exhaustion as a failed candidate under the original remaining search budget.
Create conservative repeated-structure relation definitions, consume checked graph definitions, and learn reference selection from actual checked uses.
Add question-only compositional roots with complete sibling grouping before splitting.

training: Only each seed own native-search solutions after ordinary kernel and atomic Graph admission. No imported proofs, teacher corpus, pretrained weights or earlier candidate checkpoints. Original 1308 TRAIN questions plus 395 generated learning questions from 190 disjoint construction groups. Acquisition balances the original dependency groups and the four generated topic groups; full proof/context provenance stays outside model features.

model.backend: Burn CPU Flex SIMD float32, no Rayon workers

selection.method: Keep all original selection questions; append two cases from each of four ID-ordered construction roots in every generated topic. No model-outcome filtering.
selection.promotion: Strictly more certified successes across 64 cases, no lost original selection solution, and no earlier-anchor regression. Rejection retains the exact incumbent weights and Adam.

confirmation.generator: curriculum/frontier.rs: canonical duplicates and source siblings are joined before SHA-256 construction-component buckets; bucket 1 supplies confirmation, bucket 0 selection, buckets 2..4 learning.
confirmation.method: Two ID-ordered cases from eight held-out construction components per topic. Freeze source, bank, evaluator and comparator before inference. All three seeds finish learning before any confirmation search.
confirmation.comparator: Actual exported initial model and zero-update Adam paired with this seed retained checkpoint. Identical inference source, search rules, limits, question ordering, job seeds and checked definition dictionary.
confirmation.success: Mean certified-success gain >=5 percentage points, no negative seed and at least two strictly positive seeds.
confirmation.uncertainty: Paired construction-group bootstrap, 20000 deterministic draws and 95% interval. An interval crossing zero leaves the improvement inconclusive outside this fixed generated bank. Report topic breakdowns and technical failures in all denominators.
confirmation.symbolic_control: One fixed-action-order native solver at 32 and 128 expansions, after all learning finishes; report separately from the paired fresh-model comparison.

definition_lookup.role: Secondary reference-selection measurement; never a promotion trigger or a substitute for proof success.
tracks: Known checked definitions in new formula contexts.
Previously unseen empty, successor, inductive and natural-number predicates.
definition_lookup.oracle: For each proposed ID, the unchanged native checker must accept a newly reconstructed proof whose actual direct dependency contains that definition. Multiple valid choices are valid alternatives.
definition_lookup.features: Only the goal, actual context, rule, premises and expanded definition meaning. No artifact IDs, labels, generator names or provenance enter model tensors.
definition_lookup.limits: Known-definition cases share their underlying definitions; report counts and tracks without treating variants as independent mathematics.

exclusions: All original 241 reserved questions, original external held-outs, the retired 200-case confirmation, and every generated reserved component are excluded from learning. The retired 200-case set is not evaluated again.
limitations: Synthetic construction roots measure transfer within the declared procedural population, not unrestricted mathematics.
One AI author designed the generator and evaluation; no independent human semantic agreement is measured.
A conservative natural-number predicate does not establish the existence or uniqueness of a natural-number set or implement standalone numeric terms.
Only bounded supported certificate and definition closures train the learner; unsupported cases remain explicit.
No production, physical multi-host or general model-quality qualification.
Improvement over a paired random initialization does not establish superiority to the fixed-order symbolic control.
stopping: Exactly three fresh seeds, two 128-question acquisition rounds each, at most 250 updates per candidate, and one frozen confirmation. Preserve every negative or incomplete attempt; do not tune on confirmation.
